inside_region: workload original in-Run assertions and timers
jsc_first_call_frontend_policy: included and disclosed unless a preparation mechanism is later validated
adapter_policy: separate preloaded file outside timer; QuickJS -I versus d8/jsc multiple-file loading
future_calibration_policy: powers of two; smallest common N with every engine internal region >=1000 ms; independent pilot processes
future_statistics_policy: all raw retained; no outlier deletion; same warmup policy per table; median, mean, sample stddev, Tukey IQR, min/max; ratio denominator explicitly named
clock_semantics: monotonic elapsed time, fractional milliseconds, process-local differences
floating_payload_check: finite/nonnegative; formal strictly positive; inner <= outer+5ms
clock_quality_gate: timer_recovery/audit.json PASS plus every calibration/formal sample consistency check
